targets.authors: Foa EB, Huppert JD, Leiberg S, Langner R, Kichic R, Hajcak G, Salkovskis PM.
targets.title: The Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory:development and validation of a short version.
targets.evidence_quote: The results suggest that the Chinese version of the OCI-R has a good fit for the model of the original and other western versions of OCI-R developed by Foa et al [9].
targets.outcome_quote: The confirmatory factor analysis confirmed the six-factor structure of the OCI-R, namely washing, checking, ordering, obsessing, mental neutralizing, and hoarding. The results suggest that the Chinese version of the OCI-R has a good fit for the model of the original and other western versions of OCI-R developed by Foa et al [9].
targets.outcome_reasoning: The central six-factor finding is explicitly confirmed in Chinese samples. Lower mean scores and alpha coefficients are discussed as quantitative differences while reliability and validity remain supported. Other validation papers provide contextual comparisons rather than separately designed replication targets.
